title: Blood glucose not displaying correctly in notification bar
body: Hey all, encountering a problem where my BG isn't showing up in the notification bar, just the xdrip logo. When I bring down the notification pull down I can see my BG. Started when I restarted my phone for unrelated reasons. Cheers
